30#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
31pub(crate) struct ColoredGlyph {
32    pub(crate) glyph_id: GlyphId,
33    // Some formats like COLR and SVG allow drawing the same glyph
34    // with a different context color, so we need to store that as well.
35    pub(crate) context_color: rgb::Color,
36}
37
38impl ColoredGlyph {
39    pub(crate) fn new(glyph_id: GlyphId, context_color: rgb::Color) -> ColoredGlyph {
40        Self {
41            glyph_id,
42            context_color,
43        }
44    }
45}
46
47#[derive(Debug)]
48pub(crate) struct Type3Font {
49    font: Font,
50    glyphs: Vec<ColoredGlyph>,
51    widths: Vec<f32>,
52    cmap_entries: FxHashMap<Gid, (String, Option<Location>)>,
53    glyph_set: HashSet<ColoredGlyph>,
54    index: usize,
55}
56
57impl Type3Font {
58    pub(crate) fn new(font: Font, index: usize) -> Self {
59        Self {
60            font,
61            glyphs: Vec::new(),
62            cmap_entries: FxHashMap::default(),
63            widths: Vec::new(),
64            glyph_set: HashSet::new(),
65            index,
66        }
67    }
68
69    // Unlike CID fonts, the units per em of type 3 fonts does not have to be 1000.
70    pub(crate) fn unit_per_em(&self) -> f32 {
71        self.font.units_per_em()
72    }
73
74    pub(crate) fn is_full(&self) -> bool {
75        self.count() == 256
76    }
77
78    pub(crate) fn count(&self) -> u16 {
79        u16::try_from(self.glyphs.len()).unwrap()
80    }
81
82    #[inline]
83    pub(crate) fn covers(&self, glyph: &ColoredGlyph) -> bool {
84        self.glyph_set.contains(glyph)
85    }
86
87    #[inline]
88    pub(crate) fn get_gid(&self, glyph: &ColoredGlyph) -> Option<u8> {
89        self.glyphs
90            .iter()
91            .position(|g| g == glyph)
92            .and_then(|n| u8::try_from(n).ok())
93    }
94
95    #[inline]
96    pub(crate) fn add_glyph(&mut self, glyph: ColoredGlyph) -> u8 {
97        if let Some(pos) = self.get_gid(&glyph) {
98            pos
99        } else {
100            assert!(self.glyphs.len() < 256);
101
102            self.glyph_set.insert(glyph);
103            self.glyphs.push(glyph);
104            self.widths
105                .push(self.font.advance_width(glyph.glyph_id).unwrap_or(0.0));
106            u8::try_from(self.glyphs.len() - 1).unwrap()
107        }
108    }
109
110    #[inline]
111    pub(crate) fn get_codepoints(&self, gid: Gid) -> Option<&str> {
112        self.cmap_entries.get(&gid).map(|s| s.0.as_str())
113    }
114
115    #[inline]
116    pub(crate) fn set_codepoints(&mut self, gid: Gid, text: String, location: Option<Location>) {
117        self.cmap_entries.insert(gid, (text, location));
118    }
119
120    #[inline]
121    pub(crate) fn font(&self) -> Font {
122        self.font.clone()
123    }
124
125    #[inline]
126    pub(crate) fn identifier(&self) -> FontIdentifier {
127        FontIdentifier::Type3(Type3Identifier(self.font.clone(), self.index))
128    }
129
130    pub(crate) fn serialize(&self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, root_ref: Ref) -> Chunk {
131        let mut chunk = Chunk::new();
132
133        let mut rd_builder = ResourceDictionaryBuilder::new();
134        let mut font_bbox = Rect::from_xywh(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0).unwrap();
135
136        let glyph_streams = self
137            .glyphs
138            .iter()
139            .enumerate()
140            .map(|(index, glyph)| {
141                let mut stream_surface = StreamBuilder::new(sc);
142                let mut surface = stream_surface.surface();
143
144                // In case this returns `None`, the surface is guaranteed to be empty.
145                let drawn_color_glyph = text::draw_color_glyph(
146                    self.font.clone(),
147                    glyph.context_color,
148                    glyph.glyph_id,
149                    Transform::default(),
150                    &mut surface,
151                );
152
153                if drawn_color_glyph.is_none() {
154                    // If this code path is reached, either we are dealing with a glyph that has no outline
155                    // (like .notdef), or it means we tried to create a Type3
156                    // font from a font that does not have any (valid) color/bitmap/svg table.
157                    // Therefore, as a last resort we draw the outline glyph as a black glyph.
158                    // PDF does have the concept of shape glyphs which take the color or where
159                    // they are drawn from.
160                    // The problem with those is that they seemingly have very bad viewer support. For
161                    // example, filled glyphs with gradients become broken in some viewers,
162                    // and stroking does not work at all consistently. Because of this,
163                    // we don't bother trying to implement it for now.
164
165                    // If this is the case (i.e. no color glyph was drawn, either because no table
166                    // exists or an error occurred, the surface is guaranteed to be empty.
167                    // So we can just safely draw the outline glyph instead without having to
168                    // worry about the surface being "dirty".
169                    if let Some(path) = glyph_path(self.font.clone(), glyph.glyph_id) {
170                        surface.set_fill(Some(Fill::default()));
171                        surface.set_stroke(None);
172                        surface.draw_path(&Path(path));
173                    }
174                };
175
176                surface.finish();
177                let stream = stream_surface.finish();
178                let mut content = Content::new();
179
180                // I considered writing into the stream directly instead of creating an XObject
181                // and showing that, but it seems like many viewers don't like that, and emojis
182                // look messed up. Using XObjects seems like the best choice here.
183                content.start_color_glyph(self.widths[index]);
184                let x_object = XObject::new(stream, false, false, None);
185                if !x_object.is_empty() {
186                    font_bbox.expand(&x_object.bbox());
187                    let x_name = rd_builder.register_resource(sc.register_resourceable(x_object));
188                    content.x_object(x_name.to_pdf_name());
189                }
190
191                let stream = content.finish();
192
193                let font_stream = FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_content_stream(
194                    stream.as_slice(),
195                    &sc.serialize_settings(),
196                )
197                .finish(&sc.serialize_settings());
198
199                let stream_ref = sc.new_ref();
200                let mut stream = chunk.stream(stream_ref, font_stream.encoded_data());
201                font_stream.write_filters(stream.deref_mut());
202
203                stream_ref
204            })
205            .collect::<Vec<Ref>>();
206
207        let resource_dictionary = rd_builder.finish();
208
209        let descriptor_ref = if sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version() >= PdfVersion::Pdf15 {
210            Some(sc.new_ref())
211        } else {
212            None
213        };
214        let cmap_ref = sc.new_ref();
215
216        let mut flags = FontFlags::empty();
217        flags.set(
218            FontFlags::SERIF,
219            self.font
220                .postscript_name()
221                .is_some_and(|n| n.contains("Serif")),
222        );
223        flags.set(FontFlags::FIXED_PITCH, self.font.is_monospaced());
224        flags.set(FontFlags::ITALIC, self.font.italic_angle() != 0.0);
225        flags.insert(FontFlags::SYMBOLIC);
226        flags.insert(FontFlags::SMALL_CAP);
227
228        let italic_angle = self.font.italic_angle();
229        let ascender = font_bbox.bottom();
230        let descender = font_bbox.top();
231
232        let mut gids = self
233            .glyph_set
234            .iter()
235            .map(|g| g.glyph_id)
236            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
237        gids.sort();
238        let base_font = base_font_name(&self.font);
239
240        if let Some(descriptor_ref) = descriptor_ref {
241            // Write the font descriptor (contains metrics about the font).
242            let mut font_descriptor = chunk.font_descriptor(descriptor_ref);
243            font_descriptor
244                .name(Name(base_font.as_bytes()))
245                .flags(flags)
246                .bbox(font_bbox.to_pdf_rect())
247                .italic_angle(italic_angle)
248                .ascent(ascender)
249                .descent(descender)
250                // Adobe recommends these for tagged PDF for 1.5+ (descriptors for Type3 fonts
251                // are only written for 1.5+ in the first place, so no additional checks needed)
252                // so we write them as well.
253                // Unfortunately we have no way of determining the actual family name, so we just
254                // take the next best thing
255                .family(Str(base_font.as_bytes()))
256                .stretch(
257                    match skrifa::attribute::Stretch::new(self.font().stretch()) {
258                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::ULTRA_CONDENSED => {
259                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::UltraCondensed
260                        }
261                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::EXTRA_CONDENSED => {
262                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::ExtraCondensed
263                        }
264                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::CONDENSED => {
265                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::Condensed
266                        }
267                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::SEMI_CONDENSED => {
268                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::SemiCondensed
269                        }
270                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::NORMAL => {
271                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::Normal
272                        }
273                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::SEMI_EXPANDED => {
274                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::SemiExpanded
275                        }
276                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::EXPANDED => {
277                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::Expanded
278                        }
279                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::EXTRA_EXPANDED => {
280                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::ExtraExpanded
281                        }
282                        skrifa::attribute::Stretch::ULTRA_EXPANDED => {
283                            pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::UltraExpanded
284                        }
285                        // Fallback
286                        _ => pdf_writer::types::FontStretch::Normal,
287                    },
288                )
289                .weight(match self.font.weight() as i32 {
290                    150..250 => 200,
291                    250..350 => 300,
292                    350..450 => 400,
293                    450..550 => 500,
294                    550..650 => 600,
295                    650..750 => 700,
296                    750..850 => 800,
297                    other => {
298                        if other < 150 {
299                            100
300                        } else {
301                            900
302                        }
303                    }
304                });
305
306            font_descriptor.finish();
307        }
308
309        let mut type3_font = chunk.type3_font(root_ref);
310        resource_dictionary
311            .to_pdf_resources(&mut type3_font, sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version());
312
313        // See https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5067 as to why we write this.
314        type3_font.name(Name(base_font.as_bytes()));
315        type3_font.bbox(font_bbox.to_pdf_rect());
316        type3_font.to_unicode(cmap_ref);
317        type3_font.matrix(
318            Transform::from_scale(
319                1.0 / (self.font.units_per_em()),
320                1.0 / (self.font.units_per_em()),
321            )
322            .to_pdf_transform(),
323        );
324        type3_font.first_char(0);
325        type3_font.last_char(u8::try_from(self.glyphs.len() - 1).unwrap());
326        type3_font.widths(self.widths.iter().copied());
327        if let Some(descriptor_ref) = descriptor_ref {
328            type3_font.font_descriptor(descriptor_ref);
329        }
330
331        let mut char_procs = type3_font.char_procs();
332        for (gid, ref_) in glyph_streams.iter().enumerate() {
333            char_procs.pair(format!("g{gid}").to_pdf_name(), *ref_);
334        }
335        char_procs.finish();
336
337        let names = (0..self.glyphs.len() as u16)
338            .map(|gid| format!("g{gid}"))
339            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
340
341        type3_font
342            .encoding_custom()
343            .differences()
344            .consecutive(0, names.iter().map(|n| n.to_pdf_name()));
345
346        type3_font.finish();
347
348        let cmap = {
349            let mut cmap = UnicodeCmap::new(CMAP_NAME, SYSTEM_INFO);
350
351            for g in 0..self.glyphs.len() {
352                let g = u8::try_from(g).unwrap();
353                let entry = self.cmap_entries.get(&g);
354                write_cmap_entry(&self.font, entry, sc, &mut cmap, g);
355            }
356
357            cmap
358        };
359
360        let cmap_stream = cmap.finish();
361        let mut cmap = chunk.cmap(cmap_ref, &cmap_stream);
362        cmap.writing_mode(WMode::Horizontal);
363        cmap.finish();
364
365        chunk
366    }
367}

369pub(crate) type Type3ID = usize;
370
371// A font can have multiple Type3 fonts, if more than 256 glyphs are used.
372// We use this struct to keep track of them.
373#[derive(Debug)]
374pub(crate) struct Type3FontMapper {
375    font: Font,
376    fonts: Vec<Type3Font>,
377}
378
379impl Type3FontMapper {
380    pub(crate) fn new(font: Font) -> Type3FontMapper {
381        Self {
382            font,
383            fonts: Vec::new(),
384        }
385    }
386}
387
388impl Type3FontMapper {
389    /// Given a requested glyph coverage, find the corresponding font identifier of the
390    /// font that contains it.
391    pub(crate) fn id_from_glyph(&self, glyph: &ColoredGlyph) -> Option<FontIdentifier> {
392        self.fonts
393            .iter()
394            .position(|f| f.covers(glyph))
395            .map(|p| self.fonts[p].identifier())
396    }
397
398    /// Given a font identifier, return the corresponding Type3 font if it is part of
399    /// that type 3 font mapper.
400    pub(crate) fn font_from_id(&self, identifier: FontIdentifier) -> Option<&Type3Font> {
401        let pos = self
402            .fonts
403            .iter()
404            .position(|f| f.identifier() == identifier)?;
405        self.fonts.get(pos)
406    }
407
408    pub(crate) fn font_mut_from_id(
409        &mut self,
410        identifier: FontIdentifier,
411    ) -> Option<&mut Type3Font> {
412        let pos = self
413            .fonts
414            .iter()
415            .position(|f| f.identifier() == identifier)?;
416        self.fonts.get_mut(pos)
417    }
418
419    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
420        self.fonts.is_empty()
421    }
422
423    pub(crate) fn fonts(&self) -> &[Type3Font] {
424        &self.fonts
425    }
426
427    pub(crate) fn add_glyph(&mut self, glyph: ColoredGlyph) -> (FontIdentifier, Gid) {
428        // If the glyph has already been added, return the font identifier of
429        // the type 3 font as well as the Type3 gid in that font.
430        if let Some(id) = self.id_from_glyph(&glyph) {
431            let gid = self
432                .font_from_id(id.clone())
433                .unwrap()
434                .get_gid(&glyph)
435                .unwrap();
436            return (id, gid);
437        }
438
439        if let Some(last_font) = self.fonts.last_mut() {
440            if last_font.is_full() {
441                // If the last Type3 font is full, create a new one.
442                let mut font = Type3Font::new(self.font.clone(), self.fonts.len());
443                let id = font.identifier();
444                let gid = font.add_glyph(glyph);
445                self.fonts.push(font);
446                (id, gid)
447            } else {
448                // Otherwise, insert it into the last Type3 font.
449                let id = last_font.identifier();
450                (id, last_font.add_glyph(glyph))
451            }
452        } else {
453            // If not Type3 font exists yet, create a new one.
454            let mut font = Type3Font::new(self.font.clone(), self.fonts.len());
455            let id = font.identifier();
456            let gid = font.add_glyph(glyph);
457            self.fonts.push(font);
458            (id, gid)
459        }
460    }
461}

463pub(crate) fn base_font_name(font: &Font) -> String {
464    const REST_LEN: usize = 1 + 1 + IDENTITY_H.len();
465    let postscript_name = font.postscript_name().unwrap_or("unknown");
466
467    let max_len = 127 - REST_LEN;
468
469    let trimmed = &postscript_name[..postscript_name.len().min(max_len)];
470
471    trimmed.to_string()
472}

474#[cfg(test)]
475mod tests {
476    use crate::color::rgb;
477    use crate::text::type3::{ColoredGlyph, Type3FontMapper};
478    use crate::text::Font;
479    use crate::text::GlyphId;
480    use crate::util::test_utils::NOTO_COLOR_EMOJI_COLR;
481
482    #[test]
483    fn type3_more_than_256_glyphs() {
484        let font = Font::new(NOTO_COLOR_EMOJI_COLR.clone(), 0).unwrap();
485        let mut t3 = Type3FontMapper::new(font.clone());
486
487        for i in 2..258 {
488            t3.add_glyph(ColoredGlyph::new(GlyphId::new(i), rgb::Color::black()));
489        }
490
491        assert_eq!(t3.fonts.len(), 1);
492        assert_eq!(
493            t3.fonts[0].add_glyph(ColoredGlyph::new(GlyphId::new(20), rgb::Color::black())),
494            18
495        );
496
497        t3.add_glyph(ColoredGlyph::new(GlyphId::new(512), rgb::Color::black()));
498        assert_eq!(t3.fonts.len(), 2);
499    }
500}
